phrases: Now there's more of you. Each piece can be used on its own.
You're not a witch anymore — just a set of meat chunks.
Your body blew apart, and every piece is still beautiful.
Now you're just meat. Chunks of meat with ready-made holes.
You've become part of the abyss — torn to pieces and put to proper use.
You're torn apart now, but that won't stop anyone who wants your remains.
The body is shredded to scraps, and each scrap is a toy for those who wander in the dark.
You're divided into parts. Each part serves its master forever.
Your splitting marked the start of a new cycle of service to the abyss.
